= Block image floats
:float-image: inline-image-dimensions.svg

== Left float

image::{float-image}[Left float,width=200,float=left]

The paragraph after a left float contains enough text to make its position relative to the image easy to inspect. It continues across several phrases and extends beyond the height of the image.

== Right float

image::{float-image}[Right float,width=200,float=right]

The paragraph after a right float contains enough text to make its position relative to the image easy to inspect. It continues across several phrases and extends beyond the height of the image.

== Consecutive paragraphs

image::{float-image}[Consecutive paragraphs,width=280,float=left]

The first paragraph contains enough text to occupy part of the image height.

The second consecutive paragraph makes it possible to inspect how long the image affects following paragraph layout.

== Non-paragraph boundary

image::{float-image}[Listing boundary,width=200,float=left]

[source]
----
This listing starts below the image.
----

== Full-width image

image::{float-image}[Full width,float=right,width=100%]

This paragraph starts below an image that occupies the full available width.

== Float precedence

image::{float-image}[Float overrides align,width=200,float=right,align=left]

The valid right float takes precedence over the conflicting left alignment.

== Invalid float fallback

image::{float-image}[Invalid float,width=200,float=invalid,align=center]

An invalid float falls through to the valid centered alignment.
